formal_tuple: K_rec = (q, I, P, B, H, U, V, Omega)
note: Explicit incompleteness is a feature. Components that depend on a target cannot be instantiated before S7.3 selects one, and pretending otherwise would hide a decision.

q_rec.statement: reconstruct one observed scalar plasma or state quantity from the other task-admissible contemporaneous observations

exclusion_rules: exact duplicates and aliases of the target
quantities whose definition contains the target
quantities with verified upstream dependence on the target
quantities with UNRESOLVED ancestry relative to the target (fail-closed)
I_rec.sibling_rule: primary boundary excludes same-family siblings; full-boundary variant is a declared sensitivity

provenance_relaxed_variant.reason: frozen human decision H-B: the primary paper needs one clean, target-independent study; no rescue path built on partially resolved ancestry

efit_lineage_recovery_campaign.reason: frozen human decision H-A; the fail-closed cost was accepted prospectively

H_rec.forbidden_use: knowledge may not count as validation evidence

practical_equivalence.rule: A and B practically equivalent iff |RMSE_A - RMSE_B| <= delta_equiv
practical_equivalence.reading: within one SE OR within the 0.01 practical floor

se_definition.step_1: aggregate the three validation blocks within each DEVELOPMENT discharge
se_definition.step_2: compute the paired candidate difference per development discharge
se_definition.step_3: SE_delta = standard error of that paired discharge-level difference across the 20 development discharges

practical_equivalence.supersedes: V1 conjunction (AND), which made the floor inoperative exactly when SE was small

primary_metric.name: calibration-normalized RMSE
primary_metric.epsilon_note: no outcome-tuned epsilon; a zero-scale block is declared invalid rather than rescued
primary_metric.also_reported: raw RMSE in the target physical unit
primary_metric.s7_3_requirement: development target feasibility must report whether any zero-scale calibration block exists; the primary target must have valid normalized scoring across all required development blocks
primary_metric.floor_interpretation: the 0.01 practical floor is 1% of the calibration target standard-deviation scale

sequence: STEP A: fit on [0,0.40); score A on [0.40,0.50); freeze the A score
only after A scoring is irrevocably complete may those target values act as ordinary historical calibration observations
STEP B: fit on [0,0.60); score B on [0.60,0.70); freeze the B score
STEP C: fit on [0,0.80); score C on [0.80,0.90)
a_target_value_may_never_influence: target, ontology, support or hyperparameter choices that are supposed to be frozen
validation_geometry.external_cohort: remains GLOBALLY SEALED before S7.10; block-local protection governs only within-discharge rolling-origin sequencing

gate_V3_definition.per_discharge: NRMSE_method,s = mean over blocks A,B,C of NRMSE_method,s,b
gate_V3_definition.per_baseline: Delta_j = mean over EXTERNAL discharges s of (NRMSE_REL,s - NRMSE_Bj,s)
gate_V3_definition.ci_role: reported, not used as a significance threshold for V3

gate_V6_definition.v1_defect: V6 referred to 35/27, which are parent-object counts, not the external cohort the gate operates on

outcomes.PASS: pooled V3 passes and the practical direction is non-adverse in both eras
outcomes.PASS_WITH_QUALIFICATION: pooled V3 passes, but one era is practically tied relative to a trivial baseline; report and narrow the interpretation
outcomes.FAIL_FOR_FULL_DOMAIN: pooled V3 passes only because one era dominates while the other is materially worse than B0 or B1 by more than 0.01

gate_V6_definition.fail_for_full_domain_consequence: does not erase the result; the final Omega_rec claim must be narrowed rather than averaged across the processing discontinuity

primary_metric.epsilon_note: no outcome-tuned epsilon; a zero-scale block is declared invalid rather than rescued
primary_metric.also_reported: raw RMSE in the target physical unit
primary_metric.s7_3_requirement: development target feasibility must report whether any zero-scale calibration block exists; the primary target must have valid normalized scoring across all required development blocks
primary_metric.floor_interpretation: the 0.01 practical floor is 1% of the calibration target standard-deviation scale

robust_relative_variation.target_level_score: RRV_dev = median_s(RRV_s) over the 20 frozen development discharges
robust_relative_variation.rationale: ordinary CV = sd/|mean| is undefined or explosive for near-zero means and meaningless for sign-changing trajectories; RRV is zero-safe and scale-relative

frozen_human_decisions.decision: DO NOT undertake an EFIT-lineage recovery campaign for the primary study
frozen_human_decisions.reason: the strict experiment may simply lose the 15 LINEAGE_PARTIAL equilibrium quantities under fail-closed provenance; that cost was accepted prospectively and keeps the primary study simpler and cleaner

frozen_human_decisions.decision: DO NOT declare a PROVENANCE_RELAXED secondary variant
frozen_human_decisions.reason: the primary paper needs one clean, target-independent reconstruction study; a rescue path built on partially resolved ancestry would undermine it

frozen_human_decisions.decision: DO NOT override the frozen primary target classes
frozen_human_decisions.reason: eligibility classes stand as frozen in V1
calibration-sample economy on the worst admissible grid
